**Solution:** `out/T2/plan.yaml` — a BrainSurgery plan with 58 transforms:
- 48 `concat` transforms (one per layer × 3 head-bearing tensors) that slice out and rejoin the two kept row/column blocks around head 5, writing each result to a `__pruned`-suffixed temporary name (concat can't sweep across all layers in one call — each `from` entry must resolve to exactly one tensor)

- 3 `move` transforms (regex capture-rewrite `\1` over all 16 layers at once) renaming the temporaries back onto the original tensor names
- 4 `assert` transforms implementing the required checks (shapes on layer 0, total tensor count = 244)

**Result:** ran once, succeeded (`brainsurgery out/T2/plan.yaml`, exit 0), wrote `out/T2/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors.
